data.one_liner: Reorderable grid widget with drag‑and‑drop support
data.what_it_does: Provides a drop‑in replacement for GridView that allows items to be reordered via drag and drop. It exposes callbacks for reorder start, completion, and optional locking of specific items.
use_when: You need a grid where users can reorder items by dragging
You want a simple, declarative API without custom drag handles
You need callbacks to update your data model after reordering
avoid_when: You require highly custom drag handles or animations not supported by the package
You need a non‑grid reorderable list (use ReorderableListView instead)
strengths: Supports locking specific items from being dragged
Easy to integrate with existing state management
weaknesses: Only supports grid layouts, not list or custom slivers beyond provided ones
Limited customization of drag handles compared to building your own widget
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import the package; no special permissions or build_runner needed
